This User Agreement (the "Agreement") is a legal agreement between you ("you" or the "user") and the Project Lumen team ("we", "us", or "Project Lumen") that governs your use of the Project Lumen mobile application (the "app") and its related services. By downloading, installing, or using the app, you agree to be bound by the terms of this Agreement. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please stop using the app.
Project Lumen is a free, open-source eye-care and focus application. It helps you look after your eyes during long sessions of screen work by providing gentle rest reminders, Pomodoro-style focus sessions, and local usage statistics. The app is designed to be a productivity reminder tool, not a medical device.
Eye-rest reminders. The app periodically reminds you to take a break from the screen, based on the schedule you choose. Reminders are scheduled on your device and may appear as in-app notifications or as an optional overlay. You can enable, disable, and adjust them at any time.
Focus sessions. The app offers Pomodoro-style focus sessions that split your work into timed focus periods and short breaks. When a focus period ends, the app can remind you to rest. Focus timing is computed and stored on your device.
Local usage statistics. The app tracks local statistics such as rest history, focus history, estimated viewing distance, and ambient-light trends so you can review how you use your eyes over time. These statistics are generated from data gathered on your device and are stored locally on your device only. We do not collect, upload, or sell this information.
Camera use. With your permission, the app may use the camera to estimate the distance between your eyes and the screen and to analyze blinks and signs of dry eyes. This analysis runs on your device using on-device machine learning. Camera frames are processed locally and are not saved to your device or uploaded to any server. The camera is never used in the background without your consent, and you can revoke camera access at any time from your system settings.
Device installation ID. When you first use the app, we generate a random installation ID on your device. The ID is stored in an encrypted store on your device and is used to distinguish your installation. You are not required to provide any personal information to use the core features of the app.
Optional diagnostics. The app may include optional diagnostic features such as telemetry, crash reports, face-analysis samples, and an inventory of installed apps. These features are turned off by default. They transmit data only if you explicitly enable them. Any data you choose to share is used solely to improve the app and is handled in accordance with applicable law.
Cloud features. Some features, such as email sign-in and cloud backup or sync of your settings and statistics, are available only after you sign in to your account. You are under no obligation to create an account, and the core features of the app work fully offline without one.
Free and open source. Project Lumen is free and open source and is released under the Apache License, Version 2.0. You may use, study, share, and improve the source code under that license. The source code is available from the official GitHub repository. Please obtain the app only from the official repository; we do not publish or endorse paid or modified redistributions.
User responsibilities. You are responsible for providing your own device, power, and data connection, and for complying with the rules and laws that apply where you use the app. You agree to use the app only for its intended purpose and to keep your account credentials, if any, secure.
Acceptable use. You agree not to misuse the app, including by attempting to interfere with its operation, reverse engineer the closed portions of the app beyond what applicable law permits, circumvent any technical protection, or use the app to violate the rights of others. You also agree not to redistribute the app for a fee or misrepresent it as a paid product.
No medical advice. Project Lumen is a productivity reminder tool, not a medical or vision-care product. It does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any eye condition, and its features are not a substitute for professional advice. If you experience persistent eye discomfort, fatigue, blurred vision, or any other concern, please consult a qualified eye-care professional.

These services are operated by their respective providers under their own terms and privacy practices. When you enable optional features that use these services, your use of them is subject to the terms of those providers. We are not responsible for the content or behavior of such services.

Upon termination, your right to use the app ends, and we may delete data associated with optional accounts to the extent required by applicable law. Your locally stored data is never accessed remotely and can be removed by uninstalling the app or clearing its data.
